title: The canonical single-quotient reduction projection
statement: Let A be a commutative coefficient ring with datum d [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], f:U→V an edge of the original small pro-etale sites, and R_T:D(T,A)→D(Fun(N^op,Mod(A_T))) the universal strict reduction [def-sp-constant-reduction-models]. For n in N^op, let E_T,n be exact evaluation localized to derived categories [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. Put F_T,n=R_T followed by E_T,n. Define θ_n:F_V,n ⋙ Lf^* ≅ Lf^* ⋙ F_U,n as the associator, R_V whiskered with the inverse of the canonical pull/evaluation isomorphism, the normalized R/f* isomorphism whiskered with evaluation, and the final associator. Define π_n:Rf_* ⋙ F_V,n → F_U,n ⋙ Rf_* to be the adjunction mate of θ_n.hom [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. All maps use the existing derived units and counits. This definition chooses no comparison isomorphisms.
